newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 2.5 lower vs dlr at 1,054.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 2.5 lower vs dlr at 1,054.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 2.5 pesos lower against the dollar at 1,054.50 on late buying of U.S. currency by two major banks, interbank dealers said.
The peso's fall ended three consecutive days of gains that had seen it move up nearly eight pesos.
"The exchange rate went up practically just minutes before the market close thanks to two big banks that must have been short (dollars)," one dealer said.

He and others noted that the peso hit an intraday high of 1,049.60 at midday before trending lower. Dealers reported $158 million in trading and said the peso's low for the day was a short-lived 1,055.50.
